keyFindings.description: Pre-existing in this PR's relay (present at a2a0a2a1): resolve (:491-530) sends a listed client's current state from the room but never raises the clock local holds for it. Alice listed at 5, batch nil; her heartbeat at 6 applied, observer not yet recorded; flush sends alice@6; she leaves (tombstone 6); a purge frees the tombstone before touched's snapshot; the removal is built at the relay's clock 5; record applies it (5 == held); the late heartbeat is dropped (not live). Other processes hold 6 and drop the null at 5, so her cursor stays ~30 s. Fix: in resolve, raise local[room][client] to the clock sent, under r.mu, for clients still listed (never relist). Failing-first test needed.

New in e1f4fa334: the lock-guard test's observer has its own deadline (:676-681) and calls t.Errorf and roomWait(t) from the write goroutine; when the outer select's t.Fatalf (:690) ends the subtest first, the late t.Errorf on a finished test panics the test binary and aborts the package. Its comment (:603-605) says a read lock taken twice is taken, but the writer queued at :661 blocks a second read lock. Wait on <-queued alone and let the outer select be the only deadline; correct the comment.

The new heartbeat test (:503-590) copies its twin (:401-488); the twin still waits with requireAwareness (up to roomWait), so it can pass after the 30 s expiry with no removal sent. Share one driver and the bounded wait.

Comments: :322 says a state is listed at the room's clock (it is listed at its own clock unless settled); :335-339 and the local field :233-236 name two cases and omit a reader's first state; resolve :487-488 says every nil was read live (the common heartbeat path is not read); awarenessClientStanding :443-446 names only answers; the race-test header :3-10 omits the purge test and names the wrong file for the process pair (process_pair_test.go).

verified: Round-7 finding closed: a state entry for an unlisted client (or one listed at a later clock) is settled by one awarenessClientStanding read under r.mu; not live -> dropped whole, so it neither relists the client nor replaces the pending removal (:409-413). The only unread state path is listed with clock >= held, which precedes the departure's removal record.
TestAReadersHeartbeatRecordedOverItsOwnRemovalStillLeavesTheOtherProcess holds the heartbeat's record between touched and record and fails at a2a0a2a1 (tester: 2 of 2).
Round-7 no-behaviour items done: comments, dead store, the two test comments, race tests split into awareness_relay_race_test.go (756 lines; awareness_relay_test.go 515), answered parameter gone.
Lock order unchanged: the only ygo call under r.mu is EncodeUpdate's read lock.
